featured.deck: Landfall near Gopalpur around noon Friday, winds 90–100 km/h gusting to 110. 300,000 evacuated; 423 rescue teams deployed.
featured.headline: Akvan comes ashore in Odisha

featured.deck: Thursday's 9–6 ruling: Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in 2017, the first state convicted. Reparations ordered.
featured.headline: The world absorbs the genocide verdict

featured.deck: Trump said on Thursday he is 'not rushing' and will 'see what happens' after January 1; the Senate rejected a war-powers curb 51–48.
featured.headline: Trump puts the Iran decision off to 2027

featured.deck: Trump, Xi and Putin met 80 minutes in Shenzhen, signing a four-point declaration — silent on Ukraine and Iran.
featured.headline: Three presidents sign, wars unsolved

featured.deck: A Houthi missile damaged the PIF Tower on Thursday, blowing out windows on seven to eight floors. No casualties.
featured.headline: A Houthi missile hits Riyadh's PIF Tower

featured.deck: COP31's closing day in Antalya: no deal yet. Thursday's draft, cut from 144 paragraphs to 80, drops fossil fuels.
featured.headline: COP31's last day: fossil fuels off the table

featured.deck: Europe is ready to negotiate with Russia — but only with Europe and Kyiv at the table, leaders in Berlin say.
featured.headline: Europe ready for talks with Russia

featured.deck: Third strike in four days: Neptune missiles hit the railway span overnight, halting trains. Free ferries start Friday.
featured.headline: Bridge attack halts Crimea rail a third time

featured.deck: Sensor Tower estimates 19.1m copies and $1.84bn, mostly pre-orders. Take-Two has not confirmed it.
featured.headline: GTA VI passes $1.84bn on launch day

featured.deck: Biggest IPO ever: $81.3bn at $83 a share, closing up 17% at $97.17 — but the Dow fell 1,101 on Thursday.
featured.headline: Anthropic's debut can't stop the slide

footer: Stories are as reported on Friday 20 November 2026; where an event began earlier in the week, the Friday development is the story. Disputed claims are attributed. Sources: Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, Al Jazeera and others. Original drawings.
